title: 2022 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: Let the taxicab distance between points \((x_1,y_1)\) and \((x_2,y_2)\) in the coordinate plane be given by \(|x_1-x_2|+|y_1-y_2|.\) For how many points \(P\) with integer coordinates is the taxicab distance between \(P\) and the origin less than or equal to \(20?\)

solutions.text:
For each \(k\ge1,\) the set \(|x|+|y|=k\) contains exactly \(4k\) lattice points, and \(k=0\) gives the single origin.

The total is \[ \begin{aligned} &1+\sum_{k=1}^{20}4k=1+4\cdot\frac{20\cdot21}{2} \\ &=1+840=841. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Count the lattice points on each “diamond” \(|x|+|y|=k\) separately
There are \(4k\) points with \(|x|+|y|=k\) for \(k\ge1,\) plus the origin
